title: Diagonal Tension: Skin, Stringers and Doubler
summary: At the same applied shear load, what changes when a doubler is added to an aluminium skin-and-stringer panel? A one-file finite-element model meshes the panel with plane-stress quadrilaterals, stringers as axial bars and the doubler as a local membrane thickness, solves both variants by sparse conjugate gradient in a Web Worker, and compares mass, compliance, probe displacements and stresses, principal tension by region and stringer forces, with A and B maps on one colour scale. Linear elastic and pre-buckling, with a self-check, JSON, CSV and a narrated Markdown deck to open in beamdswitch. Runs offline.
